summary: Both integer inputs are capped at 50, so the complete legal domain contains only 2,500 pairs and cannot support an honest asymptotic scaling experiment for the fixed arithmetic solution.

replacement_checks.evidence: The closed form performs one fixed-factor multiplication and one addition regardless of either input value.

Authored cases cover both minima, each independent maximum boundary, both maxima together, and asymmetric interior values; exhaustive validation also evaluates every one of the 2,500 legal pairs against direct operation-count reasoning.
